fact: A bright giant in the Scorpion's raised tail, carrying an ancient Mesopotamian name.
bio: Sargas (Theta Scorpii) is a yellow-white bright giant roughly 300 light-years away, one of the leading stars in the curving tail of Scorpius near its stinger.
cultural: The name appears to be of Sumerian or Babylonian origin, a rare survival from Mesopotamian star-lore. In the sky it lies along the Scorpion's tail as it sweeps through the bright clouds of the southern Milky Way.
